title: MPSC recruitment row: MSU president’s hunger strike enters 3rd day

ai.summary: Mizo Students' Union president Laldinsanga began a hunger strike on November 25 demanding MPSC chairman R Lalramnghaka resign over alleged recruitment errors and administrative lapses, with the protest entering its third day.

facts.claim: Mizo Students’ Union (MSU) president Laldinsanga’s hunger strike demanding the resignation of Mizoram Public Service Commission (MPSC) chairman R Lalramnghaka entered its third day on Wednesday
facts.quote: Mizo Students’ Union (MSU) president Laldinsanga’s hunger strike demanding the resignation of Mizoram Public Service Commission (MPSC) chairman R Lalramnghaka entered its third day on Wednesday

facts.claim: Laldinsanga has been fasting outside the MPSC office since Monday
facts.quote: Laldinsanga has been fasting outside the MPSC office since Monday

facts.claim: He claimed that no government representative had approached him to address the demands
facts.quote: He claimed that no government representative had approached him to address the demands

facts.claim: The MPSC has committed more than 20 errors since the chairman assumed office
facts.quote: The MPSC has committed more than 20 errors since the chairman assumed office

facts.claim: The student body alleged that the issue was not linked to any single incident but reflected the commission’s functioning since Lalramnghaka assumed office on May 20, 2024
facts.quote: The student body alleged that the issue was not linked to any single incident but reflected the commission’s functioning since Lalramnghaka assumed office on May 20, 2024

facts.claim: It claimed the MPSC had issued at least 24 corrigenda and was facing four court cases during the period
facts.quote: It claimed the MPSC had issued at least 24 corrigenda and was facing four court cases during the period

facts.claim: Lalramnghaka, however, said he would step down "if it was God’s will"
facts.quote: Lalramnghaka, however, said he would step down "if it was God’s will"
